name: Junior Saints
description: The Junior Saints, also known as the Ridgewood Junior Saints, were a street gang based in the Ridgewood neighborhood on the Brooklyn-Queens border, active in the late 1950s and early 1960s. They were rivals of the Halsey Bops of Bushwick, Brooklyn. In 1960, police broke up a planned Junior Saints ambush against the Halsey Bops that had been staged along railroad tracks behind a local ball field, with members armed with homemade zip guns and at least one rifle. The bust and its aftermath were covered by the New York Daily News or Daily Mirror.
